compendium.name: Arrows
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 gp per 20 · **Gear slots** 1 slot per 20

Ammunition for shortbows or longbows.

compendium.name: Backpack
compendium.body:
**Cost** 2 gp · **Gear slots** 0 (the first backpack is free to carry)

Holds all the gear you can carry. Don't lose it.

compendium.name: Caltrops
compendium.body:
**Cost** 5 sp per bag · **Gear slots** 1

Tiny, triangle-shaped iron spikes. A living creature that steps on caltrops takes 1 damage and can only move at half speed for 10 rounds.

compendium.name: Coin
compendium.body:
**Cost** varies · **Gear slots** 1 slot per 100 (the first 100 are free to carry)

One gold piece (gp) is worth 10 silver pieces (sp) or 100 copper pieces (cp).

compendium.name: Crossbow bolts
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 gp per 20 · **Gear slots** 1 slot per 20

Ammunition for crossbows.

compendium.name: Crowbar
compendium.body:
**Cost** 5 sp · **Gear slots** 1

Grants advantage on checks to pry open stuck objects.

compendium.name: Flask or bottle
compendium.body:
**Cost** 3 sp · **Gear slots** 1

Glass container that holds one draught of liquid.

compendium.name: Flint and steel
compendium.body:
**Cost** 5 sp · **Gear slots** 1

A small fire starter. With it, routine attempts to light a fire always succeed.

compendium.name: Gem
compendium.body:
**Cost** varies · **Gear slots** 1 slot per 10

Gems come in numerous varieties and are very valuable.

compendium.name: Grappling hook
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 gp · **Gear slots** 1

A rope anchor with three curved tines.

compendium.name: Iron spikes
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 gp per 10 · **Gear slots** 1 slot per 10

Strong spikes, each with a hole for threading rope. Can be hammered in with weapons or other iron spikes.

compendium.name: Lantern
compendium.body:
**Cost** 5 gp · **Gear slots** 1

Casts light up to a double near distance (see Light, pg. 84). Requires oil. Has a shutter to hide the light.

compendium.name: Mirror
compendium.body:
**Cost** 10 gp · **Gear slots** 1

A small, polished mirror.

compendium.name: Oil flask
compendium.body:
**Cost** 5 sp · **Gear slots** 1

Fuels a lantern for one hour of real time. Thrown, one flask covers a close area and burns for 4 rounds, dealing 1d4 damage each round.

compendium.name: Pole
compendium.body:
**Cost** 5 sp · **Gear slots** 1

Wooden, 10' long.

compendium.name: Rations
compendium.body:
**Cost** 5 sp per 3 · **Gear slots** 1 slot per 3

One day of food and water supply for one person.

compendium.name: Rope, 60'
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 gp · **Gear slots** 1

Hemp, 60' long.

compendium.name: Torch
compendium.body:
**Cost** 5 sp · **Gear slots** 1

Sheds light to a near distance (see Light Sources, pg. 84). Burns for one hour of real time.

compendium.name: Crawling Kit
compendium.body:
**Cost** 7 gp · **Gear slots** 7

A starting bundle containing:

- Backpack ×1
- Flint and steel ×1
- Torch ×2
- Rations ×3
- Iron spikes ×10
- Grappling hook ×1
- Rope, 60' ×1

compendium.name: Leather armor
compendium.body: **Cost** 10 gp · **Gear slots** 1 · **AC** 11 + DEX mod

compendium.name: Chainmail
compendium.body:
**Cost** 60 gp · **Gear slots** 2 · **AC** 13 + DEX mod

Disadvantage on stealth and swim checks.

compendium.name: Plate mail
compendium.body:
**Cost** 130 gp · **Gear slots** 3 · **AC** 15

Cannot swim. Disadvantage on stealth checks.

compendium.name: Shield
compendium.body:
**Cost** 10 gp · **Gear slots** 1 · **AC** +2

Occupies one hand.

compendium.name: Mithral
compendium.body:
**Cost** ×4 the base price · **Gear slots** −1 · Metal armor only

Mithral armor has no penalty to stealth or swim.

compendium.name: Bastard sword
